card.opportunity_illinois: Advance to Illinois Ave. If you pass Go, collect $200.

card.opportunity_nearest_utility: Advance to the nearest utility. If owned, roll the dice and pay ten times the result. If unowned, you may buy it.
card.opportunity_nearest_transport: Advance to the nearest railroad and pay double rent. If unowned, you may buy it.
card.opportunity_reading: Advance to Reading Railroad. If you pass Go, collect $200.
card.opportunity_jail: Go directly to Jail. Do not pass Go and do not collect $200.

card.community_opera: Grand opera opening. Collect $50 from every player.
card.community_birthday: It is your birthday. Collect $10 from every player.
card.community_repairs: You are assessed for street repairs. Pay $40 per house and $115 per hotel.
card.community_beauty: You won second prize in a beauty contest. Collect $10.
